svg.text: How long one critic call takes, and how much of it is thinking
Every critic call in the three paid windows, one dot each, on an A100 at the critic's card values. Thinking tokens are counted by the logging proxy.
Not drawn: 1 empty reply (Lightning, 160 s, thinking ran to the 16,384-token cap; retried).
Median prompt: 194 tokens for a verdict check, 376 for a flaw check (it also carries a checker's reasoning).
